Polynomials and degree: A polynomial has non-negative whole-number powers. Its degree is the highest power of x.
Linear polynomials and their graphs: A linear polynomial ax + b has a straight-line graph with slope a and y-intercept b.
Zeroes of a linear polynomial: The zero of ax + b is −b/a, the x-coordinate where the graph meets the x-axis.
Linear polynomials in real life: Linear polynomials model fixed-plus-rate situations. A line through two points is found from its slope and intercept.
